title: Improving Heart-Focused Medical Question Answering in LLMs via Variance-Aware Rubric Rewards with GRPO
abstract: arXiv:2606.05174v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models can support medical question answering, but privacy, cost, and reliability still limit their clinical use in focused domains. Can rubric-based reinforcement learning bring a locally deployable model close to much larger systems? We study Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for heart-focused medical question answering with rubric supervision from RaR-Medicine. Rather than rely on binary rubric aggregation or a single overall score, our variance-aware reward framework builds continuous rewards from criterion-level outcomes. It preserves partial credit and reduces reward sparsity. We adapt a Qwen3-14B policy with low-rank adapters and quantized weights. On a held-out heart-related HealthBench subset, the best GRPO variant improves accuracy from 0.362 to 0.502 and F1 from 0.532 to 0.668 over the base model, close to GPT-OSS-120B. translated_title: 基于GRPO与方差感知量规奖励改进大语言模型的心脏医学问答
translated_abstract: 大语言模型可以支持医学问答，但隐私、成本和可靠性仍然限制了其在聚焦领域的临床应用。基于量规的强化学习能否使本地可部署的模型接近规模大得多的系统？我们研究了使用来自RaR-Medicine的量规监督的组相对策略优化（GRPO）在心脏聚焦医学问答中的应用。我们的方差感知奖励框架不依赖于二值量规聚合或单一总分，而是从标准层面的结果构建连续奖励，从而保留部分得分并减少奖励稀疏性。我们使用低秩适配器和量化权重对Qwen3-14B策略进行适配。在留出的心脏相关HealthBench子集上，最佳的GRPO变体相较于基础模型将准确率从0.362提升至0.502，F1分数从0.532提升至0.668，接近GPT-OSS-120B的表现。一位独立临床医生将大多数回复评为临床可接受（61%）
tldr: 本文提出结合GRPO的方差感知量规奖励框架，使本地可部署的Qwen3-14B模型在心脏医学问答上的准确率从0.362提升至0.502，性能接近GPT-OSS-120B等大型系统。
en_tdlr: A variance-aware rubric reward framework combined with GRPO improves heart-focused medical question answering, boosting a locally deployable Qwen3-14B model's accuracy from 0.362 to 0.502, approaching the performance of much larger systems like GPT-OSS-120B.
